## Problem

A claimed leaf shows only the word claimed in the tree dashboard; the owner wants a percent there (requested by Santa for the owner).

## Done when

A claimed leaf row shows a bar: 0% claimed, 25% draft PR, 50% evidence, 75% PR ready, 90% merged; totals unchanged.
seen.title: qew progress --tree: a claimed leaf shows a bar and percent from its pull request and evidence
